base_member_text: [L52-L58] (MED/error-handling) Transfer output and exit status are discarded, allowing failed uploads to be reported as finished and an index to be published for missing artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L29,L35,L46,L58] (HIGH/upload-failure-propagation) Transfer return codes are ignored and diagnostics discarded, allowing failed uploads to produce success messages and a download index containing unavailable binaries.

adversarial.rationale: scpcopyfile discards subprocess.call status at L58 and returns normally; distribute then appends the binary link and uploads the index at L29-L46. Neither its command-line entry point nor the surrounding configuration scripts check binary-transfer success, so a failed binary upload followed by a successful index upload exposes unavailable downloads.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L14-L27] (MED/input-contract) Glob results are parsed using a raw prefix replacement and fixed path positions without validating the platform/configuration layout or supported configuration names.
audit_member_text: [L14,L21-L24] (MED/path-parsing) Discovery and path splitting assume bindir ends with a separator, so a normal directory argument without that suffix can shift platform and configuration fields or match sibling prefixes.

adversarial.rationale: The command-line entry point passes bindir unchanged (L65,L78), with no separator normalization. Without the suffix, the glob loses one directory level and can match sibling prefixes; replace/split at L21 also preserves a leading empty component for ordinary paths, with no subsequent validation.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L55-L58] (MED/shell-quoting) Paths, credentials and destination are concatenated unquoted into a shell command, so spaces or shell metacharacters can alter command interpretation.
audit_member_text: [L55-L58] (HIGH/shell-command-construction) Paths, username, and password are concatenated unquoted into a shell command, so spaces or metacharacters can change transfer arguments or execute unintended commands.

adversarial.rationale: The full helper constructs one shell string from the executable, credentials and paths at L53-L58, without quoting or escaping at either caller. A space in workdir splits the executable path, and shell metacharacters in password or source remain active before pscp runs.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L14-L15,L37-L46] (LOW/empty-input) An empty artifact glob still publishes an empty download index without reporting that no binaries were found.
audit_member_text: [L14-L15,L19-L20,L40-L46] (MED/publication-completeness) An empty glob result still replaces the download page with an empty list and reports copying complete.

adversarial.rationale: files may be empty while ln remains empty, but neither the loop nor the entry point tests that condition. With an available template and successful final transfer, L40-L46 publishes the empty replacement page and L35 has already announced completion.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L20-L33] (MED/artifact-collision) Multiple ZIP files in one platform/configuration directory receive the same destination name and overwrite each other.
audit_member_text: [L14-L15,L20-L29] (MED/artifact-identity) Every zip in a configuration directory is uploaded under the same revision-derived name without checking its provenance, so stale or multiple archives can overwrite the intended release.

adversarial.rationale: The glob accepts every zip and newname uses only revision, platform and configuration (L14-L27), never the discovered archive name or embedded revision. Two archives in the same recognized configuration therefore target exactly the same remote file, and no producer/provenance check was found in the source tree.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

[L60-L78] (MED/import-side-effects) Argument parsing and distribution run unconditionally at module import, so importing the helper can raise an argument error or trigger publication.
[L57] (LOW/output-escaping) The source path is interpolated into a TeamCity message without escaping service-message delimiters or line breaks.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: L57 inserts source directly into a single-quoted TeamCity message without any escaping; source comes from globbed paths or workdir-derived workhtml, and neither caller sanitizes it. A path containing an apostrophe or service-message control character can therefore corrupt the emitted message.
